title: Failures for a Lay Follower
html:
• Aṅguttara Nikāya 7.30 Numbered Discourses 7.30
  • 3. Vajjisattakavagga 3. The Vajji Seven

Vipattisutta Failures for a Lay Follower

Sattimā, bhikkhave, upāsakassa vipattiyo …pe… “Mendicants, there are these seven failures for a lay follower …

sattimā, bhikkhave, upāsakassa sampadā …pe…. There are these seven accomplishments for a lay follower …”

Dasamaṁ.
